Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

two and
two forms of I.D. e.g. driving license,
Cost join per year (without current student card): £
Number of items allowed:(members of public)
Fine start at £
Computers can be booked up to hours in advance
Library holds most national papers, all and magazines
Need to use photocopier
tutor is John

transcript.en: Good morning, North College Library.
transcript.zh: 早上好，这里是北方大学图书馆，

transcript.en: How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 我能帮你做些什么

transcript.en: I was wondering if it was possible to join the library.
transcript.zh: 我想知道我是否能加入图书馆

transcript.en: Are you a student at North College?
transcript.zh: 你是北方大学的学生吗

transcript.en: No, I'm not, but someone told me it was possible to join, even if I wasn't.
transcript.zh: 不，我不是。但是有人告诉我即使我不是也能加入。

transcript.en: That's right, it is.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: Are you over 18?
transcript.zh: 你是18岁以上吗

transcript.en: That's our minimum joining age.
transcript.zh: 这是我们的最低参与年龄

transcript.en: Yes, I am.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: That's no problem then.
transcript.zh: 那就没问题了

transcript.en: Could you tell me what I have to do to join?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我应该做些什么准备才能进去吗

transcript.en: Well, you'll need to come in to the library and fill out some forms.
transcript.zh: 你需要来图书馆并填写一些表

transcript.en: You'll also need to bring two passport photos with you.
transcript.zh: 你还得带两张护照照片

transcript.en: We also need two documents for ID, so a driving licence would be fine.
transcript.zh: 我们还需要两份身份证件，所以驾驶证就可以。

transcript.en: I've got that and what else? A credit card?
transcript.zh: 好的，还有什么吗，信用卡呢

transcript.en: No, it needs to have your address on it.
transcript.zh: 不行，证件上需要有你的住址。

transcript.en: Shall I bring a bank statement, would that do?
transcript.zh: 我要带银行对账单吗，这个可以吗，

transcript.en: That'll be fine.
transcript.zh: 很好

transcript.en: Good. Does it cost anything to join?
transcript.zh: 好的 加入图书馆花钱吗

transcript.en: Well, it's free for students here but otherwise it's ￡125 per year or ￡25 if you've got a current student card from another college.
transcript.zh: 对本校学生免费，但是对其他人一年要收125英镑，或者如果你有别的大学的在读学生证就收取25英镑。

transcript.en: I was at Westerly College until last year but now I've got a job at Jefferson's steel factory.
transcript.zh: 去年之前，我在西方大学读书，但是现在我在杰弗逊的钢铁厂上班。

transcript.en: Er, it's more expensive than I thought.
transcript.zh: 这比我想的要贵

transcript.en: My local library is free.
transcript.zh: 我们当地的图书馆是免费的

transcript.en: But you'll find they don't have the range of reference books or facilities which we buy for our students.
transcript.zh: 但是你会发现它们没有我们为学生购买的各式参考书和设施

transcript.en: That's why you have to pay to be an external member.
transcript.zh: 那就是为什么你不得不交钱成为外部会员

transcript.en: I see. How many books can I borrow?
transcript.zh: 我懂了 我能借多少书

transcript.en: We allow twelve items borrowed at any one time if you're a student, and that includes CDs, DVDs and videos.
transcript.zh: 如果你是学生，我们允许学生一次借12个，其中包括CD、DVD和视频。

transcript.en: However, it's only eight items for members of the public.
transcript.zh: 然而，对公众只能借出去8样。

transcript.en: Fine. And how long can I have them for?
transcript.zh: 好的，我能借阅多久

transcript.en: Well, you can have both fiction and reference books for four weeks which isn't bad really.
transcript.zh: 你可以借阅4周的小说和参考书，这很不错。

transcript.en: And what happens if I return them late?
transcript.zh: 如果我还晚了怎么办

transcript.en: Like all libraries there's a fine system in place.
transcript.zh: 跟所有图书馆一样有罚款制度

transcript.en: The minimum fine is ￡1.50 but it can be much higher for some items - up to ￡5 per week.
transcript.zh: 最低罚款额是1.50英镑，但是有些物品的罚款可能更高，高达每周5英镑。

transcript.en: We'll give you a booklet with all the details when you join.
transcript.zh: 当你加入之后，我们会给你一本详细的小册子。

transcript.en: You can always renew items if they're not required by anyone else by telephoning or logging on to our website.
transcript.zh: 如果其他人不借阅的话，你可以通过电话或登录我们的网站续借。

transcript.en: What about the computers? Can I use them free of charge?
transcript.zh: 那么电脑呢 我能免费使用吗

transcript.en: For college students it's free, but for external members like yourself, the first hour is free and then we make a nominal charge of ￡ 1 per hour thereafter.
transcript.zh: 对大学学生是免费的，但是对像你这样的外部会员，第一个小时免费，之后象征性的收取每小时一英镑。

transcript.en: Do I have to book in advance for them?
transcript.zh: 我需要提前预订吗

transcript.en: Oh, yes, it's advisable.
transcript.zh: 是的，这样很明智

transcript.en: Most people tend to book twenty-four hours in advance although sometimes you can get one with only six hours' notice.
transcript.zh: 多数人通常提前24小时预订，尽管有时你提前6个小时也能订到，

transcript.en: However, the earliest you can book a computer is forty-eight hours before you need it, and you can only book one hour at a time.
transcript.zh: 然而，你最早预订电脑的时间是提前48小时，每次你只能预订一个小时。

transcript.en: If no-one else has booked the computer out, then you may be able to have another hour if you want.
transcript.zh: 如果没有别人订电脑，如果你需要的话，你也许能够再多用一个小时。

transcript.en: We have a wide range of databases, so the computers are in great demand.
transcript.zh: 我们有一个包罗万象的资料库，所以电脑的需要量很大。

transcript.en: I'm thinking of doing some writing and I might need to access national newspapers.
transcript.zh: 我在考虑写一些文章，所以我需要全国性报刊的信息。

transcript.en: Do you have them on these databases?
transcript.zh: 资料库里面有这方面信息吗

transcript.en: We do indeed.
transcript.zh: 我们当然有

transcript.en: We've got all the big nationals, The Guardian and The Observer, The Independent and The Times and Sunday Times.
transcript.zh: 我们有所有的大型全国性报刊，如《卫报》，《观察家报》，《独立报》，《泰晤士报》和《星期日泰晤士报》，

transcript.en: We've also got all the local papers and a wide selection of magazines.
transcript.zh: 我们还有所有的地方报纸和各种各样的杂志

transcript.en: Excellent. I assume you have photocopying facilities?
transcript.zh: 好极了 我想你们那里有复印设备吧

transcript.en: Of course.
transcript.zh: 当然

transcript.en: 5p a sheet for both A4 and A3 black-and-white copies and 40p a sheet for colour.
transcript.zh: A4和A3大小的黑白复印是每张5便士，彩色复印是每张40便士，

transcript.en: You can get a card from the counter here - it doesn't take coins.
transcript.zh: 你可以从柜台这里领取一张卡，那里不收取硬币。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Oh, by the way, another thing I was wondering about was if you ran any writing classes through the library?
transcript.zh: 顺便说一下，我想知道你们的图书馆有没有写作课程，

transcript.en: We do, but you'll have to speak to John Grantingham about that.
transcript.zh: 我们有，但是你得咨询约翰·葛兰汀汉姆。

transcript.en: He's our resident author.
transcript.zh: 他是我们的常驻作家

transcript.en: He runs the creative writing classes.
transcript.zh: 创造性写作的课程由他教授

transcript.en: John ...Grant....Could you spell that for me please?
transcript.zh: 约翰·葛兰……你能为我拼一下吗

transcript.en: Certainly.
transcript.zh: 当然

transcript.en: G-R-A-N-T-I-N-G-H-A-M.
transcript.zh: G-R-A-N-T-I-N-G-H-A-M

transcript.en: Are the classes here at the library?
transcript.zh: 是在图书馆上课吗？

transcript.en: Yes - he's here on Thursday evenings, oh no sorry, Friday - he's just changed it.
transcript.zh: 是的，他周四晚上会在这里。不，对不起，是周五，他刚改了时间。

transcript.en: You can contact him by emailing the library.
transcript.zh: 你可以通过给图书馆发邮件联系他

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Right, well that's about all I need to know.
transcript.zh: 这些就是我想了解的

transcript.en: Thank you.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: I'll be along later this week to join.
transcript.zh: 这周晚些时候我会去的

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见
